draft.body:
Dear Professor Pei-Hsien Hsu,

I’m contacting you because your profile connects mixed reality, physical interaction and design-build work, and lists Lane 3067, an educational experiment in Hsinchu’s old town. The work is described here: https://arch.nycu.edu.tw/en/about/faculty/phsu/.

I’ll be in Taiwan and am developing Proxy Society as a possible PhD project. I want to test a community-room entrance where a resident can delegate a booking to an AI agent while still choosing to arrive, wait and speak with staff. I would compare a visible shared handoff with a separate service point through plans and a full-scale mock-up.

Could we discuss which aspect should become the architectural research question, and whether that study could fit NYCU’s Civil Engineering Group G architecture doctorate? A brief lab conversation during my visit would help me frame the first prototype.

Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
